scenes.stage_direction: The household's polished public account meets the records retained by its workers. Amara speaks for herself.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: It says you were unable to care for Ethan.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I was working. Feeding him. I was sleeping in the next room.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The person who wrote this had never met you.

metadata.evidence_summary: The document falsely describes Amara as unable to care for Ethan.
